bio.text: Debbie Wasserman Schultz was first sworn in to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2005 and represents part of Broward County, Florida.
She previously served in the Florida House of Representatives and the Florida Senate.
She attended the University of Florida, earning a bachelor's degree in political science in 1988 and a master's degree in 1990, and lives in Weston, Florida.
